title: Observed
description: The observation envelope, CONTRACTS.md §1.2/§1.4. Every value in both the on-site and live-ingest contracts that comes from outside the domain layer is wrapped in exactly this shape. `value`'s own schema is not fixed here — a concrete usage (e.g. Observed<Outcome>) composes this schema with `properties.value` refined for that field. This file is the authority on envelope shape: field presence, the omission rule for `eventTime`, and the closed `reason` vocabulary; it does not attempt to describe every concrete `value` type used throughout CONTRACTS.md §2.

oneOf.title: known
oneOf.description: eventTime is OPTIONAL and, per CONTRACTS.md §1.2, MUST be omitted (key absent) rather than sent as null when there is no applicable event time. It is never appropriate to add eventTime to 'required' when refining this schema for a concrete field.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601, always wall-clock, always with an explicit offset or Z. Never used for merge ordering (CONTRACTS.md §4 INV-6) — display and staleness computation only.

sourceTag.description: operator-write and operator-assertion sit outside the §4 ranking table (INV-2's carve-out) — see CONTRACTS.md §4 for how they are presented.

unavailableReason.description: Closed vocabulary. Never free text — CONTRACTS.md §1.2/§1.4. 'not-applicable' is distinct in kind from the other three: the fact does not exist for this entity at all, permanently, not a temporary source failure (e.g. a forerunner's ICFId, CONTRACTS.md §2.5).
